summary: RFC 9097 defines a way to measure one-way IP capacity, but that method needs a feedback channel so the receiver can steer the sender's rate almost in real time. This Standards Track document defines the UDP Speed Test Protocol (UDPSTP), which provides that feedback and can run those measurements and related ones.

eli5.summary: To learn how fast a water pipe can carry water, one person pours while the other shouts "more!" or "less!". This sets the rules for shouting.

questions: how to measure one-way ip capacity
